arStrings.szText: Fury Skill: Rend enemies in front of you, inflicting heavy bleeding.
Dealing direct damage with {c_important}Rend{/c} extends the duration of {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} on enemies by {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Rend{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|+%|]{/c} increased Size and {c_number}[{SF_37}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage. Consecutive swings of {c_important}Rend{/c} further increases its Size by {c_number}[{SF_29}*100|+%|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_29}*{SF_30}*100|+%|]{/c}, until you stop swinging.
Enemies that die while Bleeding from {c_important}Rend{/c} spread {c_number}[{SF_35}*100|%|]{/c} their remaining Bleed onto a random Close enemy.

{c_important}Rend{/c} now deals Fire damage.

Each slash creates a wave of fire, dealing {c_number}{payload:VARIANTC_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and an additional {c_number}{dot:VARIANTC_BURNING}{/c} Burning damage over {c_number}{buffduration:VARIANTC_BURNING}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Rend{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_48}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to enemies that are moving.
Heal for {c_number}[{SF_47}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life per second for each enemy Bleeding from {c_important}Rend{/c}.
